title: Discovering Purpose at Work
discussion_signal: The posts relay a purpose intervention that linked personal meaning to performance, retention, priorities, and parental-leave behavior, while discussion frames meaning as a management and organizational-design issue rather than only an individual preference.
linked_research_question: Can an institutionally delivered meaning intervention change work effort and life-priority choices without relying on higher pay or stronger monitoring?
limits: The post summarizes research and adds a management interpretation
LinkedIn audience and reactions are not representative
Reported organizational returns should not be treated as universal effects
